summary: Long residential south kerb where cars park; homes 14 m or more away but steep.

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 13-14 m on the south side, 19 m across the road; a cleared dirt lot sits behind the kerb nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both sides; room at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, busy road at the east end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 2P parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 9.4% in the section, 15.8% max on the stretch
Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade parts of the kerb from the south.

best_section.where: South kerb of Marmion Parade beside the cleared lot and apartment block
